The presence of multiple targets for the kinase, including the compound and Astersaponin F, supports the idea that the compound may act through this kinase to influence NH-6. The integration of these pathways highlights the kinase as a central node in the relationship between the compound and NH-6, with the compound potentially functioning as a ligand or activator of the kinase, which in turn interacts with NH-6. The evidence is robust and aligns across different paths, reinforcing the proposed mechanism.
